title: Enrollment Settings

requireApproval.label: Require Approval
requireApproval.description: Enable if you want to review and approve enrollment requests

warning: Students will see your message while their enrollment request is pending approval.

templates.standard: Thank you for your interest in our course. Your enrollment request is being reviewed by our team. We will notify you once your request has been approved.
templates.review: Your enrollment request has been received. Our team will review your application within 2 business days. You will receive an email notification with the decision.

markdownHint: You can use markdown formatting in your message.
